mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_memory_summary_watermark(tenant_id,scope_key,user_id,domain,top_level_agent_id,session_id) VALUES(#{row.tenantId},#{row.scopeKey},#{row.userId},#{row.domain},#{row.topLevelAgentId},#{row.sessionId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope_key=VALUES(scope_key)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_summary_watermark WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_summary_watermark SET revision=revision+1,source_revision=source_revision+1,next_sequence=next_sequence+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND scope_key=#{row.scopeKey} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND deletion_epoch=#{row.deletionEpoch}

UPDATE ai_memory_summary_watermark SET revision=revision+1,source_revision=source_revision+1,commit_revision=commit_revision+1,deletion_epoch=deletion_epoch+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND scope_key=#{row.scopeKey} AND revision=#{row.revision}

choose.when: FROM ai_operation_message m JOIN ai_operation_conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id JOIN ai_operation_run r ON r.id=m.run_id
FROM ai_customer_service_message m JOIN ai_customer_service_conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id JOIN ai_customer_service_run r ON r.id=m.run_id
choose.otherwise: FROM ai_operation_message m JOIN ai_operation_conversation c ON 1=0 JOIN ai_operation_run r ON 1=0

mapper.sql: CAST(m.id AS BINARY) AS id,CAST(m.run_id AS BINARY) AS run_id, AS body, SHA2(CAST( AS BINARY),256) AS content_hash,m.role, (LOWER(r.status)='succeeded' AND m.status='COMPLETED') AS completed
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE AND CAST(m.id AS BINARY)=#{message} FOR UPDATE
SELECT WHERE AND CAST(m.run_id AS BINARY)=#{run} ORDER BY m.created_at,CASE WHEN LOWER(m.role)='user' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CAST(m.id AS BINARY) FOR UPDATE

SELECT JOIN ai_memory_source s ON s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.source_object_ref=CAST(m.id AS BINARY) WHERE AND s.id=#{source} AND s.source_type='CURRENT_USER_MESSAGE' AND LOWER(m.role)='user' AND s.source_version=CAST(SHA2(CAST( AS BINARY),256) AS BINARY) FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.execution_id,p.task_id,p.user_id,a.original_session_ref,p.original_deadline FROM ai_memory_packet p JOIN ai_memory_packet_refresh a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.execution_id=p.execution_id AND a.record_kind='ANCHOR' WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.execution_id=#{execution} AND a.user_id=p.user_id AND a.original_deadline=p.original_deadline

SELECT p.id,v.version_id,v.policy_json,v.content_hmac,v.schema_version FROM ai_memory_policy p JOIN ai_memory_policy_version v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.policy_id=p.id AND v.version_id=p.current_version_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.domain=#{domain} AND p.enabled=TRUE ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 2 LOCK IN SHARE MODE

SELECT tenant_id,scope_key,message_id,content_hash,sequence_no,group_id,group_members_json,dependencies_json,policy_id,policy_version_id,expires_at FROM ai_memory_summary_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND message_id=#{message} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id AS source_id FROM ai_memory_summary_segment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_source SET grant_epoch=grant_epoch+1,source_epoch=source_epoch+1,deletion_epoch=deletion_epoch+1, retention_deadline=LEAST(retention_deadline,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND source_type='SUMMARY'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS source_id,d.id AS decision_id,d.item_id,d.target_version_id AS version_id,d.actor_id,d.actor_kind,d.decision_type, i.field_key,i.owner_id,CONVERT(i.domain USING utf8mb4) AS domain,CONVERT(i.origin_top_agent_id USING utf8mb4) AS origin_top_agent_id, CONVERT(i.lifecycle USING utf8mb4) AS lifecycle,i.current_version_id,CONVERT(v.status USING utf8mb4) AS version_status, i.grant_epoch,i.source_epoch,i.deletion_epoch FROM ai_memory_source s JOIN ai_memory_decision d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.id=s.source_object_ref JOIN ai_memory_item i ON i.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND i.id=d.item_id JOIN ai_memory_version v ON v.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND v.item_id=d.item_id AND v.id=d.target_version_id AND v.decision_id=d.id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.id=#{source} AND s.source_type='USER_PREFERENCE_DECISION' AND s.source_version=v.id AND d.actor_kind='USER' AND d.decision_type IN ('SAVE','CORRECT','REAUTHORIZE','CONFIRM') AND i.lifecycle='LIVE' AND i.current_version_id=v.id AND v.status='ACTIVE' AND v.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND v.grant_epoch=i.grant_epoch AND v.source_epoch=i.source_epoch AND v.deletion_epoch=i.deletion_epoch AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_decision rejected WHERE rejected.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND rejected.item_id=d.item_id AND rejected.target_version_id=v.id AND rejected.decision_type='REJECT')
SELECT FROM ai_memory_summary_plan WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_summary_plan SET state=#{state} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND state='FROZEN'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_summary_segment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ai_memory_summary_segment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND plan_id=#{plan}
SELECT FROM ai_memory_summary_segment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND state='COMMITTED' AND expires_at>UNIX_TIMESTAMP() ORDER BY last_sequence DESC LIMIT 32
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_summary_segment SET state='SCRUBBED',encrypted_payload=NULL,nonce=NULL,auth_tag=NULL,content_hmac=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND state='COMMITTED'
UPDATE ai_memory_summary_plan SET state='SCRUBBED',encrypted_payload=NULL,nonce=NULL,auth_tag=NULL,content_hmac=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND state<>'SCRUBBED'

UPDATE ai_memory_source s JOIN ai_memory_summary_source m ON m.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND m.message_id=s.id SET s.grant_epoch=s.grant_epoch+1,s.source_epoch=s.source_epoch+1,s.deletion_epoch=s.deletion_epoch+1,s.retention_deadline=LEAST(s.retention_deadline,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.scope_key=#{scope} AND s.source_type='MESSAGE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_memory_tombstone(tenant_id,target_type,target_id,deletion_epoch,grant_epoch,source_epoch) SELECT s.tenant_id,'SOURCE',s.id,s.deletion_epoch,s.grant_epoch,s.source_epoch FROM ai_memory_source s JOIN ai_memory_summary_source m ON m.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND m.message_id=s.id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.scope_key=#{scope} AND s.source_type='MESSAGE' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deletion_epoch=GREATEST(ai_memory_tombstone.deletion_epoch,VALUES(deletion_epoch)),grant_epoch=GREATEST(ai_memory_tombstone.grant_epoch,VALUES(grant_epoch)),source_epoch=GREATEST(ai_memory_tombstone.source_epoch,VALUES(source_epoch))
